recipe.difference: mean over RGB and region pixels of abs(clip(composite,0,1)-clip(static,0,1))
recipe.mask_decode: same frozen actor L nearest resize; sky positive float32 OpenCV linear resize then>0

limitations: Difference measures locality relative to the actual composite, not edited-region accuracy or dense ground truth.
Actor-mask exterior may include the original cast shadow. Shadow removal can be legitimate change; counts alone are not an editing acceptance test.
Masks reconstructed with unchanged pinned recipe and actual source inputs; no independent runtime mask/Scene-pose pixel snapshots are available.
Existing NPZ file hashes are bound by the canonical completed CPU export. The supplement verifies actual path/bytes and reads arrays but does not repeat large NPZ/checkpoint hashes.
